DryRun.setup:
import os, tempfile
os.chdir(tempfile.mkdtemp())
from pathlib import Path
Path('a.rxt').write_text('x')
Path('b.rxt').write_text('y')
import pathlib, sys
class WindowsPath(pathlib.PosixPath):
    def __str__(self):
        s = pathlib.PosixPath.__str__(self)
        if not sys._getframe(1).f_code.co_filename.endswith('.py'):
            s = ('C:' if s.startswith('/') else '') + s.replace('/', '\\')
        return s
    def __repr__(self): return 'WindowsPath(%r)' % (('C:' if pathlib.PosixPath.__str__(self).startswith('/') else '') + pathlib.PosixPath.__str__(self))
pathlib.Path = pathlib.WindowsPath = WindowsPath

import os, shutil
from pathlib import Path
for folder_name, subfolders, filenames in os.walk('spam'):
    for filename in filenames:
        p = Path(folder_name)
        shutil.move(p / filename, p / filename.upper())
sorted(os.listdir('spam'))

from pathlib import Path
backup_zip = zipfile.ZipFile('spam_1.zip', 'w')
for folder_name, subfolders, filenames in os.walk('spam'):
    folder_name = Path(folder_name)
    for filename in filenames:
        backup_zip.write(folder_name / filename)
backup_zip.close()
